preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) >= 1 and len(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the t subsequent lines contains a string of length between 1 and 100, consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No', 'yEs', 'nO'] for i in range(1, t + 1))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a line containing 'YES' (case-insensitive) if the string is square, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['YES', 'yes', 'Yes', 'yEs']) == (len(s) % 2 == 0 and s == s[:len(s)//2] * 2) for i, s in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output for a string s is 'YES' if and only if s is square, i.e., s can be written as a string repeated twice (len(s) is even and s == s[:len(s)//2] * 2).
